scope: Independent read-only review of root functional changes to leaderboard parsing/pairing, site calculator and wording, Awesome generator wording/counts, and CI. Relevant tests inspected; no new global test run or scientific rerun.

checks.result: New integer-count guards reject booleans, fractional counts, nonpositive n and out-of-range k; sr agrees with k/n; bounded ordered CIs contain sr; NaN fails the comparisons. Cost checks reject negative and nonfinite numeric values. load_runs catches malformed mapping failures and skips them with a warning. Existing valid JSON result serialization remains compatible.

The new version check rejects differing known init-set versions in addition to existing set/name and count checks. Unknown metadata remains permissive exactly as before; the change does not pretend to verify episode-level seeds.

Number plus Number.isSafeInteger rejects fractional, blank, nonfinite and unsafe integer input; explicit bounds reject n<1 and k outside 0..n. Invalid input clears interval width and hides the point; the next valid update restores visibility. Existing Wilson arithmetic and display values are unchanged.
checks.tests_inspected: Root VALIDATION.json records browser probes for 30/30, 0/30, 31/30, 2.5/30 and blank inputs; independent review here is source-level, not a repeated browser run.

checks.result: Count expressions remain data-derived and unchanged. The fixed September 2025 threshold is now labeled explicitly rather than as a rolling twelve months. The seven Start Here picks currently all fall within the past year. The 30/30, 73/73 and 381/381 wording now specifies fixed-size independent Bernoulli assumptions; no new arithmetic path is introduced. Chapter-plan language distinguishes implemented and planned content.

contents:read suffices for checkout and read-only validation; setup-uv has no new write requirement. ruff is in the locked dev extra installed before lint. Site --check is deterministic from the repository update date and tracked input files, matching the existing Awesome synchronization gate. Matrix and smoke commands remain unchanged.

limits: No full browser, dependency reinstall, CI service execution or scientific rerun performed by this reviewer. Parent reports 176 passing tests and final smoke checks; those execution claims are not independently duplicated here.
Review concerns the requested diff, not all pre-existing validation behavior. Optional/missing success metadata and permissive legacy pairing remain pre-existing design choices.
Python test files do not directly execute the JavaScript calculator; the recorded parent browser probes supply that interaction evidence.
